blobs.value: "Separate the Aquameta source code repo from the installed instance used for bundle/app development. Eliminate the git-repo-as-agent-trigger problem, clarify the two-daemon setup, and establish clean promotion paths from experiment → bundle → distribution."

"Run bundles/export-all.sh to snapshot current committed bundle state into JSON files in the repo. This makes bundle state durable in git before any DB or filesystem changes.\nDone when: bundles/*.json files are current and git-committed on dev."

"CREATE DATABASE aquameta_dev; load all extensions from the dev branch source (scripts/create_extensions.sql or equivalent). This becomes the test target for source-level changes.\nDone when: psql aquameta_dev shows all extensions installed, daemon not yet pointed at it."

"Add one section to AGENTS.md: git repos associated with bundles are export artifacts. Agents must never edit files in a bundle git working tree directly. The editing surfaces are psql, PGFS, and the IDE. bundle.commit() is the version control primitive; git push is downstream.\nDone when: AGENTS.md updated, companion.decision row recorded."

"The bundle.commit() NOTIFY outbox already exists (io.bundle.ai.core, ai.outbox). Add a consumer that: receives bundle_commit NOTIFY, exports the bundle in the agreed format, runs git add + git commit + git push to bundle.repository.git_url.\nConsumer can be a Go goroutine in the daemon or an external process. Decide based on whether it needs to run as the daemon user or can be a separate service.\nDone when: committing a bundle with git_url set results in a new commit appearing in the remote git repo."

"Run bundle.uncommitted_changes() and examine untracked rows by schema. Decide what to commit to bundles, what to discard. This must happen before any filesystem moves.\nDone when: all live DB state is either committed to a bundle or explicitly discarded."
"Design the export format for git-hosted bundles"

"Decide what the git repo contains: (a) raw bundle JSON snapshot (current export format), (b) per-row files organized by relation (more diff-friendly), or (c) hybrid. The NOTIFY outbox consumer writes this format on each bundle commit.\nKey tradeoff: raw JSON is simple but noisy in git diff; per-row files are diff-friendly but require a structured directory layout and an import reader that understands it.\nDone when: format decision recorded as a companion.decision row."

"Add git_url to bundle.repository and implement the NOTIFY outbox consumer that exports + pushes on each bundle commit. Git is a distribution/backup transport, not a peer editing surface — the DB remains canonical. Best implemented after workspace separation step 5 (clean install path) but not blocked by it."

"ALTER TABLE bundle.repository ADD COLUMN git_url text. Nullable — bundles without a remote are fine. Update the bundle extension SQL file (extensions/bundle/) to match. No behavior change yet; this is schema only.\nDone when: column exists, extension SQL updated, bundle.commit() on io.bundle.core.repository reflects the change."

"Counterpart to the push: given a git URL, clone or pull the export, import the bundle JSON (or per-row format) into the local DB via the existing import machinery.\nThis is the distribution mechanism — share a bundle by sharing a URL.\nDone when: bundle.import_from_git('https://example.com/my-bundle.git') imports the bundle and it appears in bundle.repository."
"Remove .git from the installed Aquameta path (or use a non-repo install path)"
"Implement NOTIFY outbox consumer for git push"

"The installed Aquameta instance should not be a git working tree — agents working on bundles/apps should not see .git/ and infer git-centric change tracking. Either install from a clean checkout to a separate path, or restructure so the running instance directory is not the repo root.\nDone when: the path agents work in for bundle/app work has no .git/ directory."

"Copy conf/bootloader.toml to conf/bootloader-dev.toml, point at aquameta_dev, different HTTP port (e.g. 8081). Verify both daemons start cleanly.\nDone when: two daemon processes running, each serving a distinct DB on distinct ports."

"Add explicit scope constraints to CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md: agents doing bundle/app work must not write to extensions/*.sql or *.go files. When a source-level problem is found, the protocol is: log companion note, open GitHub issue, stop.\nDone when: constraint is documented in AGENTS.md and a companion.decision row records it."
